paragraphs.text:
Your strength fails and an eddy sweeps you off into the fastest 
part of the stream. You are battered on the rocks and plunged 
into deep water. Your vision becomes murky.

You are underwater for 1D6 rounds. Each round, make a CON roll to 
hold your breath; if you fail, you begin to drown—on that and every 
subsequent round you suffer 1D3 damage. If you are still alive when 
you surface, attempt a Swim roll. If you succeed with the Swim roll, go 
to 191. If you fail the Swim roll, try to hold your breath with a CON 
roll; if you fail, you suffer 1D3 damage and are drowning—you have 
one last chance to escape watery death with a combined Swim and 
CON roll, but if either fails, you are dead. THE END.
